purpose: Explicit reconciliation of inherited reference drift, reproduced defect repairs and intentional rule changes; prior captures remain immutable.

profile.limits: Only Normal is simulated, for two turns; Elite combat and save/load repairs require the independent regression suite.

archives.description: Unchanged historical reference; already differed on all 390 lines before this work.
Independently captured starting main; matched the original tooling-only implementation byte-for-byte.

Node 22 capture at 6f9ac77 (main after #155, before the Smilas rework). Differs from the previous canonical file on 71 sim lines (all setup lines equal): commander reworks pushed to main on 2026-10-19 were never re-fingerprinted because PR CI only checks three scenarios.

reason: Gene Smilas rework (3f9e4fa4, c4e2d229, 753e1bc3, 3482fd7a, 28f0b520, 3b3c2460, be8b46ac; pushed directly to main 2026-10-20, documented in docs/COMMANDER_REWORK.md): Expendable Vanguard active, Human Shields and Necessary Sacrifices passives; Defensive Doctrine and his generic command/morale auras removed. Changes 32 sim lines, every one in a game where the E.U. fields Smilas (on the map or aboard a carrier); city counts change in area-18/britannia, britannia-siberia/britannia+eu and britannia-western-russia/britannia.

Drift already on main before Smilas (71 sim lines, 24 with different city counts): intentional commander reworks and balance commits pushed on 2026-10-19 (critical-chance standardization d0c76bf0; Cornelia/Suzaku, Akito, Xingke, Leila, Zero, Kallen, Jeremiah, Schneizel, Bismarck, Ayano, Xianglin, Yukiya, Rakshata, Ohgi). Per-line attribution: tools/testing/smilas-rework-validation/attribution.json.

Behaviour-preserving changes in the same range reproduce their parents on all 390 lines: #118 unified combat actions (c23dd334), a0c53d6e AI maneuver pruning, #155 (6f9ac777), #158 and #159 (c517408e).
